mapper.select: SELECT I.INQUIRY_ID AS inquiryId, I.INQUIRY_TYPE AS inquiryType, I.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, I.TITLE AS title, I.BODY AS body, I.REF_TYPE AS refType, I.REF_ID AS refId, TRIM(I.STATUS_CD) AS statusCd, I.ANSWER AS answer, I.APPLY_DATE AS applyDate, I.ANSWER_DATE AS answerDate, I.REG_DATE AS regDate FROM TB_INQUIRY I WHERE I.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ORDER BY I.REG_DATE DESC, I.INQUIRY_ID DESC

SELECT I.INQUIRY_ID AS inquiryId, I.INQUIRY_TYPE AS inquiryType, I.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, I.TITLE AS title, I.BODY AS body, I.REF_TYPE AS refType, I.REF_ID AS refId, TRIM(I.STATUS_CD) AS statusCd, I.ANSWER AS answer, I.APPLY_DATE AS applyDate, I.ANSWER_DATE AS answerDate, I.REG_DATE AS regDate FROM TB_INQUIRY I WHERE I.INQUIRY_ID = #{inquiryId} AND I.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
mapper.insert:
SELECT NVL(MAX(INQUIRY_ID), 0) + 1 FROM TB_INQUIRY
INSERT INTO TB_INQUIRY ( INQUIRY_ID, INQUIRY_TYPE, MEMBER_NO, TITLE, BODY, REF_TYPE, REF_ID, STATUS_CD, APPLY_DATE, REG_DATE ) VALUES ( #{inquiryId}, #{inquiryType}, #{memberNo}, #{title, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{body, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{refType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{refId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{statusCd}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_INQUIRY WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND REF_TYPE = 'RESV' AND REF_ID = #{resvId} AND STATUS_CD = 'WAIT' AND TITLE LIKE '숙소 환불신청%'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_INQUIRY I WHERE I.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND I.REF_TYPE = 'RESV' AND I.REF_ID = #{resvId} AND I.TITLE LIKE '숙소 환불신청%' AND I.STATUS_CD IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'DONE')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_INQUIRY I JOIN TB_RESERVATION R ON R.RESV_ID = I.REF_ID AND R.RESV_TYPE = 'STAY' WHERE I.REF_TYPE = 'RESV' AND I.INQUIRY_TYPE = 'RESERVE' AND TRIM(I.STATUS_CD) = 'WAIT' AND TO_NUMBER(R.TARGET_ID) = #{stayId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_INQUIRY I JOIN TB_RESERVATION R ON R.RESV_ID = I.REF_ID AND R.RESV_TYPE = 'STAY' WHERE I.REF_TYPE = 'RESV' AND I.INQUIRY_TYPE = 'RESERVE' AND TO_NUMBER(R.TARGET_ID) = #{stayId}
AND TRIM(I.STATUS_CD) = 'WAIT'
AND TRIM(I.STATUS_CD) IN ('APPROVED', 'DONE')
AND TRIM(I.STATUS_CD) = 'REJECTED'

SELECT I.INQUIRY_ID AS inquiryId, I.INQUIRY_TYPE AS inquiryType, I.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, M.MEMBER_NAME AS memberName, M.EMAIL AS memberEmail, I.TITLE AS title, I.BODY AS body, I.REF_TYPE AS refType, I.REF_ID AS refId, TRIM(I.STATUS_CD) AS statusCd, I.ANSWER AS answer, I.APPLY_DATE AS applyDate, I.ANSWER_DATE AS answerDate, I.REG_DATE AS regDate, R.RESV_NO AS resvNo, R.STATUS_CD AS resvStatusCd, R.TOTAL_AMOUNT AS totalAmount, S.NAME AS stayName FROM TB_INQUIRY I JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = I.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN TB_RESERVATION R ON R.RESV_ID = I.REF_ID AND R.RESV_TYPE = 'STAY' LEFT JOIN TB_STAY S ON S.STAY_ID = TO_NUMBER(R.TARGET_ID) WHERE I.REF_TYPE = 'RESV' AND I.INQUIRY_TYPE = 'RESERVE'
AND I.STATUS_CD IN ('DONE', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED')
AND I.STATUS_CD = #{statusCd}
ORDER BY I.REG_DATE DESC, I.INQUIRY_ID DESC

SELECT I.INQUIRY_ID AS inquiryId, I.INQUIRY_TYPE AS inquiryType, I.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, M.MEMBER_NAME AS memberName, M.EMAIL AS memberEmail, I.TITLE AS title, I.BODY AS body, I.REF_TYPE AS refType, I.REF_ID AS refId, TRIM(I.STATUS_CD) AS statusCd, I.ANSWER AS answer, I.APPLY_DATE AS applyDate, I.ANSWER_DATE AS answerDate, I.REG_DATE AS regDate, R.RESV_NO AS resvNo, R.STATUS_CD AS resvStatusCd, R.TOTAL_AMOUNT AS totalAmount, S.NAME AS stayName FROM TB_INQUIRY I JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = I.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN TB_RESERVATION R ON R.RESV_ID = I.REF_ID AND R.RESV_TYPE = 'STAY' LEFT JOIN TB_STAY S ON S.STAY_ID = TO_NUMBER(R.TARGET_ID) WHERE I.INQUIRY_ID = #{inquiryId} AND I.REF_TYPE = 'RESV'
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_INQUIRY SET STATUS_CD = #{statusCd}, ANSWER = #{answer, jdbcType=CLOB}, ADMIN_NO = #{adminNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, ANSWER_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE INQUIRY_ID = #{inquiryId} AND TRIM(STATUS_CD) = 'WAIT'
mapper.select: SELECT I.INQUIRY_ID AS inquiryId, I.INQUIRY_TYPE AS inquiryType, I.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, M.MEMBER_NAME AS memberName, M.EMAIL AS memberEmail, I.TITLE AS title, I.BODY AS body, I.REF_TYPE AS refType, I.REF_ID AS refId, TRIM(I.STATUS_CD) AS statusCd, I.ANSWER AS answer, I.APPLY_DATE AS applyDate, I.ANSWER_DATE AS answerDate, I.REG_DATE AS regDate FROM TB_INQUIRY I JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = I.MEMBER_NO WHERE I.INQUIRY_ID = #{inquiryId} AND (I.REF_TYPE IS NULL OR I.REF_TYPE <> 'RESV')
